tax.text: He says he would reduce the tax burden on middle-class families and supports expanding the SALT deduction.
tax.quote: who fights hard to lessen the tax burden on middle-class families, protect small businesses, and bring more job opportunities to NJ-03.

wages.text: He cosponsored the Raise the Wage Act of 2025, which would increase the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: James P. McGovern (MA); Sydney Kamlager-Dove (CA); Al Green (TX); Jonathan L. Jackson (IL); Joe Courtney (CT); Herbert C. Conaway, Jr. (NJ); Doris O. Matsui (CA); LaMonica McIver (NJ); Andrea Salinas (OR); Andre Carson (IN)

trade.text: He criticized tariffs as a tax that raises consumer costs.
trade.quote: He has talked about tariffs, he’s imposed them, and a tariff is nothing but a tax on the American people.

housing.text: He sponsored legislation allowing hospitals to develop housing for people who are homeless or housing insecure, including with zoning exemptions.
housing.quote: deemed a permitted use in all residential and nonresidential districts of a municipality and shall be exempt from local zoning restrictions

schools.text: As a state assemblyman, he sponsored New Jersey’s school funding formula and supported district accountability and public school standards.
schools.quote: sponsored New Jersey’s school funding formula; increased fiscal accountability within school districts; added technology to core curriculum standards; and modernized nutritional standards in public schools.

immigration.text: He opposed additional ICE and DHS funding until agents are subject to stronger oversight and due-process protections.
immigration.quote: I will also continue to oppose additional ICE and DHS funding until they rein in their agents and recommit to our nation’s longstanding principles of due process and humane treatment.

guns.text: He has supported federal background-check legislation and safe-storage requirements for firearms.
guns.quote: Since being elected to Congress, he has continued that work by supporting legislation such as the Bipartisan Background Checks Act of 2025 and Ethan’s Law

abortion.text: He supports codifying Roe v. Wade into federal law and protecting abortion access.
abortion.quote: It is of the utmost importance that we codify Roe v. Wade into national law so that we can protect the women of this country and their right to choose.

energy.text: He supports environmental research and expanding electric-vehicle charging infrastructure in his district.
energy.quote: This includes funding research aimed at maintaining sustainable environmental practices and supporting legislation to expand access to electric vehicle charging infrastructure in our district.

voting.text: He supports the John Lewis Voting Rights Act and has sponsored state bills to improve ballot counting and increase participation.
voting.quote: In Congress, I enthusiastically support its passage. In the Assembly, I sponsored bills that improve the ballot counting process and have fought to establish a Voting Improvement Task Force.

tax.text: He says he would lower the tax burden on middle- and working-class families.
tax.quote: It means lowering the tax burden on middle- and working-class families so they can keep more of their earnings.

debt.text: He strongly agreed that the government should cut spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: The government should cut spending in order to reduce the national debt.

safety.text: He supports providing local law enforcement with resources, training, and equipment.
safety.quote: On public safety, we must support our local law enforcement with resources, training, and equipment while securing our borders to halt the flow of fentanyl.

immigration.text: He supports strong border enforcement alongside expanded lawful work visas and a streamlined legal pathway for qualified immigrants.
immigration.quote: A secure nation requires both strong borders and a modern, functional legal immigration system.

guns.text: He describes the Second Amendment as fundamental and emphasizes protecting law-abiding gun owners’ rights.
guns.quote: The Second Amendment is a fundamental right. We should enforce laws against criminals while protecting the rights of law-abiding citizens to defend themselves and their families.

abortion.text: He supports legal protections for unborn life, with exceptions for rape, incest, and the life of the mother.
abortion.quote: I support common-sense protections for unborn life with standard exceptions for rape, incest, and to save the life of the mother.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He strongly agreed that biological males should not participate in women's sports or occupy women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

health.text: He proposes expanding insurance competition by allowing plans to be purchased across state lines and expanding health savings accounts.
health.quote: Expanding Competition: Allowing health insurance plans to be purchased across state lines and expanding Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) for everyday families.

energy.text: He supports restoring American energy independence to lower gas and grocery prices.
energy.quote: To tackle inflation, we must rein in reckless federal spending, audit government programs for waste, and restore American energy independence to lower gas and grocery prices.

voting.text: He supports photo ID and proof-of-citizenship requirements for federal elections, as well as other election safeguards.
voting.quote: I support: Mandatory Photo ID: Requiring a valid government-issued photo ID for federal elections, a common-sense measure supported by the vast majority of Americans. Proof of Citizenship: Ensuring only American citizens participate in federal elections.

wages.text: Kelly supports a living wage, stronger protections for organizing and collective bargaining, and policies modeled on the PRO Act.
wages.quote: I oppose so-called Right to Work laws and support stronger federal protections for organizing, a living wage, universal paid parental leave, and policies modeled on the PRO Act.

housing.text: Kelly says the country needs substantially more affordable housing, with infrastructure and planning for new development.
housing.quote: We need substantially more affordable housing, including public and social housing, while making sure new development is supported by appropriate infrastructure and thoughtful planning.

safety.text: Kelly supports shifting resources toward prevention, treatment, social services, and community intervention while focusing law enforcement on serious threats and violent crime.
safety.quote: I support shifting resources toward social workers, mental-health professionals, violence prevention, treatment, and community services while focusing law enforcement resources on serious threats and violent crime.

immigration.text: Kelly supports protecting asylum, refugee, and TPS programs and creating paths to legal status and citizenship; he also supports abolishing ICE.
immigration.quote: I support protecting asylum, refugee and TPS programs and providing workable paths to legal status and citizenship.

guns.text: He supports expanded background checks and other gun-safety measures while opposing a broad ban on commonly owned firearms and an assault-weapons-ban reinstatement.
guns.quote: I also support expanded background checks, secure firearm storage, community-based violence prevention, suicide prevention, and Extreme Risk Protection Orders with strong due-process protections.

abortion.text: Kelly supports federal protections for reproductive healthcare and says abortion decisions belong primarily to patients and their providers.
abortion.quote: I support reproductive freedom and believe decisions about abortion, contraception, fertility care, pregnancy, and other reproductive healthcare belong primarily to patients in consultation with their healthcare providers—not politicians.

gender.text: He says sports and sex-separated-space policies require case-specific consideration rather than one blanket rule.
gender.quote: I do not believe one blanket rule appropriately addresses every situation.

health.text: Kelly supports universal single-payer healthcare covering medical, prescription, mental-health, and preventive care.
health.quote: I support a universal single-payer healthcare system that includes medical, prescription, mental health, and preventive care.

energy.text: Kelly supports accelerating clean energy while protecting consumers and workers during the transition.
energy.quote: I also support accelerating clean energy while protecting consumers and workers during the transition.

voting.text: Kelly supports accessible registration and voting, including early and mail voting, and opposes discriminatory barriers.
voting.quote: I support strong voting-rights protections, accessible registration and voting, early and mail voting, adequate polling locations, language and disability access, and reliable paper records and election audits.

tax.text: Welzer proposes reducing taxes for below-median-income households while also advocating strongly progressive taxation and higher estate taxes.
tax.quote: Reduce taxes on incomes below the real median income of $75,000 per household.

wages.text: He supports a living wage and expanding workers’ right to unionize.
wages.quote: we need an Economic Bill of Rights establishing the rights to a living-wage job, housing, healthcare, and a secure retirement.

debt.text: He proposes strengthening Social Security and applying its payroll tax to all income, including capital gains and dividends.
debt.quote: Strengthen Social Security; remove the artificial cap on the Social Security tax for the wealthy, and apply the Social Security payroll tax to all income, including capital gains and dividends.

housing.text: He proposes public investment to make a large share of housing high-quality and income-based.
housing.quote: Implement public housing investment with a goal to make 60% of the market high-quality, income-based units (i.e., social housing).

schools.text: He says education should be a priority, with adequate resources and more equal school funding.
schools.quote: We must stop disinvestment in education and instead put it at the top of our social and economic agenda.

immigration.text: He supports a timely, dignified path to citizenship and non-custodial processing for immigrants, asylum seekers, and refugees.
immigration.quote: We need properly funded institutions to ensure a timely, ethical, transparent, and dignified path to citizenship for immigrants, asylum seekers, and refugees.

guns.text: In a 2016 campaign, he supported banning semi-automatic weapons and background checks.
guns.quote: Wants to ban semi-automatic weapons, and supports background checks.

cannabis.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he strongly agreed that marijuana should be legalized and regulated.
cannabis.quote: Marijuana should be legalized and regulated like tobacco and alcohol.

health.text: He supports a universal single-payer health system, including coverage for mental and preventive care.
health.quote: Under a universal, comprehensive, single-payer system, the administrative waste of private insurance corporations would be redirected to patient care.
